correctness.rationale: Explicit correct circular-arc parametrization, exact radial second and fourth integrals, and rotationally invariant covariance prove the chord formulas. The strictly increasing variance and strictly decreasing radial second moment on t in (0,pi/6] establish monotonicity for all odd n. Nonstandard derivative inequality was bounded rigorously via elementary Taylor inequalities; formal series yield quartic and sextic coefficients. Independent direct boundary-pair quadrature and 121 standalone tests passed, used as support rather than replacing analytic proof.

value.rationale: This answers a natural finite-data geometric-tomography problem for the canonical family of regular Reuleaux polygons: two simple normalized pairwise distance moments identify the odd arc count and width, and the first two nonzero asymptotic terms quantify exact loss of shape-discriminating power near a circle. The invariant is structurally tied to piecewise-circular constant-width geometry, not an arbitrary isolated numerical statistic.
